description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when records miss a work e-mail, a mobile number, a job title, a LinkedIn profile or company data. per record from a name + company: work e-mail ≈2.39, at most 9 credits; mobile ≈3.84, at most 12; job title ≈1.41, at most 13.5. Charged per hit for e-mail and phone. Use estimate:true first for the exact price of YOUR records (free, no key). Fills fields of contact records (work e-mail, mobile, job title, LinkedIn profile, company, domain, industry, size, place). Send records for a direct result without creating a list, or list_id and record_ids to update shared rows in place. Waits up to 25 s and returns a job_id to poll (get_job) for longer lookups.

estimate.description: true = only the price for these records, nothing runs (free, no key needed)

fields.description: Fields to fill: email, phone, job_title, linkedin_profile_url, company_name, domain, industry, city, country

list_id.description: Enrich rows of this list in place instead of sending records (e.g. the list a search_people answer named)

max_credits.description: The most this call may cost (default: the key's day budget left)

record_ids.description: With list_id: the rows' ids (`id` in a search answer)

records.description: Records as JSON objects. Any key names (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, company_name, domain, linkedin_profile_url, job_title, phone, country, city — or Vorname, Firma, Mail …); the answer says how each key was read.

request_id.description: Your id for this call — a repeat with it gets the same job
